stateDescription.running: The source currently reports this execution as running.
stateDescription.needs-input: The current ledger requires user input. Continue only in the source application.
stateDescription.completed: The source reports this record or execution as completed. This does not prove another business object completed.
stateDescription.policy-blocked: The ledger reports a policy enforcement result. This view cannot bypass or release it.
stateDescription.failed: The source reports failure. No cause beyond the provided summary is inferred.
stateDescription.cancelled: The source reports this execution as cancelled. No further outcome is inferred.
stateDescription.unknown: The latest state could not be confirmed. Refresh information without retrying the execution.
